chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Jam sessions at Mike's on 149th Street
summary: After work they jammed until morning at Mike's on 149th Street and Seventh Avenue.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: When you first came to New York did you go out to play at jam sessions and things that they had there? Did you jam around with any of the musicians when you first came?
Could you name some of the people that were here and around?

After we finished work we would play until about 3 or 4 o'clock in the morning. When you get through the most important place was Mike's here on 149th Street and 7th Avenue. Sometimes we used to be there and jam till 11 or 12 o'clock the next day.
I was thinking, when you first came to New York, when you said you were working and so forth.
Well, that's what I'm telling you now. Yeah, I just gave you the answer.
